verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any API endpoint for retrieving marketing campaign or automation-flow performance metrics. The closest item is an export of raw transactional email events from the past 7 days (brevo-docs-7), which is an adjacent feature rather than campaign or flow analytics. The warehouse sync (brevo-docs-35) covers customer data and revenue attribution (brevo-docs-9) covers e-commerce sync, so neither shows pulling campaign or flow metrics into your own systems.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull campaign and flow performance metrics through the API into my own warehouse or dashboards
